description: Mention popup (triggered by @ or [[) with People, Pages, and Date tabs (or pages only), featuring a search input, results list, and keyboard navigation, raising the selected item as a type, id, and display text. The menu is a TmOverlayPanel anchored to a zero-size virtual element pinned at the Top/Left caret coordinates — popover="manual" puts it in the browser top layer so it paints above a host TmModal. overlay.js supplies flip/shift viewport clamping (replacing adjustSlashMenuPosition) and Escape + outside-pointerdown dismissal (replacing the transparent backdrop). Panel-root styles live in the global _notion-floating-menus.css because the panel element carries the overlay's scope attribute, not this component's. On open, the search input's focus is re-asserted across ~10 animation frames (a same-keystroke render can refocus the block editable), but the loop yields once document.activeElement moves to another real non-editable element — a deliberate Tab/click never gets pulled back (CF18-3).

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Raised when the user dismisses the menu.

parameters.name: OnItemSelected
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string Type, string Id, string Display)>
parameters.description: Raised when the user picks a mention. Args: (type, id, displayText).

parameters.name: PagesOnly
parameters.description: When true only the Pages tab is shown (triggered by '[[').
